name: CC1101_DRIVER
description: ESP-IDF driver for the TI CC1101 sub-GHz transceiver. A handle-based API drives several radios over one SPI bus, and RFuzz, a dual-radio serial console on ESP32-S3, is built on top of it.

name: modbus
description: Command-line Modbus client for PLCs, drives and RTUs over TCP, UDP, RTU, ASCII and TLS. Scans register ranges, watches live values for changes, snapshots and restores device state, and ships its own simulator and interactive shell.

name: RTSP_TO_HTTP
description: Grew out of the HiveHack IoT challenge at CyberSea: finds IP cameras that expose RTSP with default credentials, then re-streams them as HLS so any browser or smart TV can play them.

name: CST-MATLAB-2.4Ghz-Antenna
description: 2.4 GHz ISM microstrip antenna for IoT boards, modelled, simulated and post-processed in CST Studio Suite entirely from a MATLAB script, with S-parameter and far-field export.

name: XDR_C2
description: Security research toolkit behind one menu: a TCP command-and-control shell, Fernet file encryption, a ransomware simulation and LSB image steganography. Built for lab use only.

name: DOS-X_ASM
description: Drawing program for DOS in 8086 assembly. Renders in VGA Mode 13h by writing straight to video memory, with line and shape primitives and saving and loading of images.

name: infoTRON
description: ESP32 lab exercises for the infoTRON 2026 mechatronics workshops I mentored: GPIO and LED labs first, then an async web server with a JSON REST API that controls the board from a browser.

name: LaTeX_MiroBoard
description: Miro app that spots LaTeX in board text boxes and renders it as formula images in a side panel, re-rendering when the source changes.

name: windots
description: Windows desktop setup with GlazeWM tiling, a yasb status bar, multi-monitor workspaces and a one-line installer.

name: Brainrot
description: Java Swing experiment in controlled chaos: erratic pop-up windows, meme bombardment and glitch audio, all stopped by a kill switch. Built to see how far Swing and users can be pushed.

name: Pyroute
description: Routing algorithm that finds the optimal path between two MAC addresses in a hierarchical JSON structure and returns the shortest route.

name: PySelenium-Bandcamp
description: Scraper that collects song titles and links from Bandcamp for a given list of artists.

name: RGBConverter
description: Conversion of images between the RGB and XYZ color spaces via matrix transformations.
